name: trustshield-ai
description: Enterprise Phishing Detection System - Full Stack

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd chrome-extension && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently 'npm run dev:backend' 'npm run dev:extension' 'npm run dev:dashboard'
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:extension
scripts.lint: npm run lint:extension && npm run lint:backend
